objects.name: Detection technique coverage: cisco-ios-suspicious-privileged-account-creation
objects.description: This analytic detects the creation of privileged user accounts on Cisco IOS devices, which could indicate an attacker establishing backdoor access. The detection focuses on identifying when user accounts are created with privilege level 15 (the highest administrative privilege level in Cisco IOS) or when existing accounts have their privileges elevated.
